infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: App Hub uses Bluetooth for offline chat and to show which other attendees are near you. It never uses your location.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: App Hub broadcasts a temporary identifier so nearby devices running the same app can find you.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: EventPulse uses the compass and motion sensors to keep the event map oriented as you turn.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EventPulse needs access to your photos so you can choose a profile picture. The image is cropped and resized on your device.

plugins.photosPermission: EventPulse needs access to your photos so you can choose a profile picture. The image is cropped and resized on your device.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: App Hub uses Bluetooth to chat with and discover nearby devices.
